newsitem.title: USA: Great Western may sell, partner fund unit.
newsitem.headline: Great Western may sell, partner fund unit.

text.p: Great Western Financial Corp said it has begun to explore "several options" for its mutual fund subsidiary, Sierra Capital Management Corp, ranging from a joint venture partnership to outright sale of the company.
But it stressed there can be no assurance that any transaction will result.

Sierra Capital Management, with $3.4 billion in assets under management, markets a family of 15 mutual funds through a separate broker-dealer subsidiary of Great Western and through other national and regional securities brokerages.
Great Western has retained the investment banking firm of Goldman Sachs to assist the company in its review.

It emphasized that it remains committed to participation in the securities business through its broker-dealer subsidiary, Great Western Financial Securities Corp (GWFSC), which is currently the focus of expansion plans.
